parameters.query:
WITH stale AS (
  SELECT a.id, a.account, a.action_type, a.created_at,
         coalesce(nullif((SELECT c.rep_email FROM clients c WHERE c.id = a.client_id), ''), (SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key='rep_notification_email')) AS rep_email
  FROM actions a
  WHERE a.status = 'recommended' AND a.created_at < now() - interval '2 days'
)
SELECT rep_email,
       json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'account', account, 'action_type', action_type, 'age_days', extract(day from now() - created_at)::int) ORDER BY created_at) AS items
FROM stale
WHERE coalesce(rep_email, '') <> ''
GROUP BY rep_email;
